categories.main_business_segments: ALUKO CO., LTD. primarily operates in aluminum extrusion manufacturing and sales, including aluminum sash, formwork, railway vehicle interior/exterior materials, LCD frames, curtain walls, and automotive parts materials. The company also engages in construction, leasing, and trading through subsidiaries. Key business divisions include retail sales of aluminum and PVC building materials, direct sales to construction and installation companies, special sales for industrial aluminum products, display and electric vehicle components sales, and construction-related aluminum formwork and curtain wall sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced aluminum extrusion technology with large-scale extrusion presses (up to 8,000 tons) and proprietary know-how accumulated over 68 years. It employs high-precision extrusion techniques for automotive structural parts, display frames, and battery module cases. The production process includes casting, extrusion, coating, painting, and processing, supported by R&D focused on lightweight, high-strength aluminum alloys and innovative manufacturing methods such as friction stir welding and variable curvature extrusion.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ALUKO serves a diverse customer base including construction companies, industrial manufacturers, electronics firms, automotive battery manufacturers, and display panel producers. Major customers include Samsung Electronics, LG Display, Panasonic, Sony, SK On, and LT Precision. The company targets markets in building materials, railway vehicles, automotive lightweight parts, electric vehicle battery components, and solar module frames.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Daejeon and overseas subsidiaries in Vietnam (Hyundai Aluminum Vina, ALK Vina), the United States (ALUKO America Inc.), Europe (ALUKO Europe KFT), India, and China (Alu Materials Dongguan Co., Ltd.). Sales and production activities cover domestic and international markets including Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: ALUKO operates mainly in the midstream segment of the aluminum supply chain, focusing on secondary aluminum processing such as extrusion and fabrication of aluminum products. It imports primary aluminum ingots and billets, processes them into finished aluminum extrusion products, and supplies these to downstream industries like construction, automotive, electronics, and renewable energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in lightweight aluminum alloys, high-strength extrusion materials, and advanced manufacturing technologies to support growth in electric vehicle battery components and renewable energy applications. It is developing battery pack housing parts and expanding into wind power equipment components. R&D efforts also focus on improving thermal insulation for building materials and enhancing aluminum sub-frame applications for automobiles. The company maintains a dedicated R&D center and invests in patent development for extrusion and welding technologies.
categories.revenue_model: ALUKO generates revenue primarily through the manufacturing and sale of aluminum extrusion products and related components. Revenue streams include product sales to construction, automotive, electronics, and industrial customers, contract-based construction and installation services, leasing income from aluminum formwork, and export sales through overseas subsidiaries. The company also earns income from processing services and trading activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The aluminum extrusion industry in South Korea is highly competitive with over 100 companies operating under a fully competitive market. ALUKO differentiates itself through its large-scale extrusion capacity, proprietary technology, and exclusive products such as wide aluminum formwork and subway vehicle frames. It holds a unique market position domestically with a focus on high value-added industrial aluminum products and strategic partnerships with major electronics and automotive companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, ALUKO reported consolidated revenues of approximately 591 billion KRW, a decrease of 8.4% from the previous year, with operating profit increasing by 8.7% to 37.6 billion KRW and net profit rising 30% to 20.5 billion KRW. The company has total assets of about 861 billion KRW and equity of 359 billion KRW, showing a stable financial position with a debt-to-equity ratio of approximately 140%. Capital has grown steadily through stock issuance and retained earnings, supporting ongoing investments and business expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ALUKO emphasizes its long-standing expertise in aluminum extrusion technology, large-scale production capacity, and ability to produce exclusive, high-quality aluminum products that meet stringent customer requirements in automotive, electronics, and construction sectors. Its products contribute to lightweighting, energy efficiency, and environmental sustainability, particularly in electric vehicle battery components and renewable energy applications. The company’s integrated production system and strong R&D capabilities enable customized solutions and innovation, providing competitive advantages in quality, performance, and market responsiveness.
